paite: Hadrak gam dou in TOUPA thu a kilak a, "Damaskas akhawlna mun ahi ding. Aram khopite TOUPA a ahi, Israel nam tengteng ahih bang un,
heading: Kho Kim A Namte Demna

paite: huan pil mah le uh agamgitpih Hamath, Tura leh Sidon tung atung ding hi.
Tura kulh muanhuaitak in akilamkhia in, dangka leivui bang in vum venvon in, kongzingte buannawi bang in dangka-eng hoih in dim mahleh.
Ngai in, TOUPA'N amah neih-le-lam alamang ding a, tuipi a ahauhsakna ahihse ding; huchi in meikuang a nekgaih ahong hi ding hi.
"Ashkelon in huai amu dia, alau ding; Gaza in leng amu dia, nakpi a suknat in a-om ding; Ekron, alametna zahlakna ahi dia; Gaza a kipan kumpipa amangthang ding a, Ashkelon luah in a-om kei ding hi.
Huchi in Ashdod ah chi siangloute ateng ding ua, Philistiate kisaktheihna ka satkhe ding hi.
Huan akam a kipan asisan ka lamang ding a, ahate kikal a kipan in akihhuainate; huchi in amah leng i Pathian a ding in khosuaksun ahi ding hi; Jebus mi bang in Judah leh Ekron ah hausa ahi ding hi.

Huan sepaih pawlte ziak in akimvel in ka inn ka um ding, huchi a kuamah apaisuak uhiam akik nawnlouhna ding un; huchi in nuaisiahmi in apaltan nawnta kei ding; tu in ka mit mahmah in ka muta hi," achi hi.

Aw Zion tanu, nakpi mahmah in kipak in; Aw Jerusalem tanu, kikou in; ngai in, na kumpipa kiniamkhiak in, sabiltung tung, sabiltungnou tuan ngei nailouhna tung a tuang in na kiang ah ahong hi; amah adiktat a, hotdamna anei.
heading: Messia Kumpi Chiamtehna

paite: Ephraim a kipan kangtalai leh Jerusalem a kipan sakol ka satkhe ding a, kidouna thalpeu satkhiak in a-om ding a; namte kiang ah lemna thu agen ding; huchi in agam tuipi a kipan tuipi tan, luipi a kipan lei tawpnate tan ahi ding hi.
Nang tungthu ah leng, na thukhun sisan ziak in tui omlouhna kokhuk a kipan in na suangkul tangte ka sawlkheta hi.
heading: Pathian Mite Tunding Nawnna

paite: Lametna suangkul a tangte, kulh muanhuai lam ah kihei un; tuni mahmah in na tung ah azahnih in ka hon dinkik ding chih ka puang hi.

Judah thalpeu bang in ka laikulta a, Ephraim thal a bawl in thalpeu ah ka bulhta hi. Aw Zion, na tapate dou ding in na tapate ka tokthou ding, Aw Grik, huchi in mihat namsau bang in, nang ka hon bawl ding hi.
Huchi in atung ah TOUPA akimu ding a, khophia bang in athal apaikhe ding; Toupa PATHIAN in pengkul amut dia, simlam pingpei toh apaikhe ding hi.

Sepaihte' TOUPA'N amaute ahunkhe ding a; suang sailim tangte asikden ding ua; anegai ding ua, uain bang in asisan uh adawn ding uh; noubemte bang in adim ding ua, maitam ningte bang in akawt ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in TOUPA a Pathian un abelamhonte bang in amau ahondam ding a; lallukhu a suangmantamte bang in agam ah atang ding uhi.
Ahi, ahoihna alian mahmah a, akilawmna athupi mahmah a; buh-le-bal in tangvalte atai ding a, uain thak in nungakte atai ding uhi.
